description: Upload a file attachment to Zendesk for use in a ticket comment, returning attachment details and an upload token valid for 60 minutes. Use an uploaded file reference, data URL, or permitted local file URL.

inputSchema.description: Request model for uploading an attachment to Zendesk.

file.description: The file to upload to Zendesk. The file name will be used for the attachment (for example, 'document.pdf' or 'error_log.txt').
file.human_parameter_description: The file you want to upload. This can be a document, image, log file, or any other file type. The file name should match the attachment name you want in Zendesk. Provide an uploaded file or direct file URL.

mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file
mimetype.title: Mimetype

name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service
name.title: Name

s3key.description: Uploaded file reference. If not provided, url must be provided.
s3key.title: S3Key

url.description: URL to a file (e.g., 'file:///path/to/file.txt' or 'https://example.com/file.pdf'). Used when an uploaded file reference is not available.
url.title: Url

file.title: File

inputSchema.title: CreateZendeskAttachmentsRequest

name: create_zendesk_attachments

CreateZendeskAttachmentsResponse.description: Response model for a Zendesk attachment upload.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the uploaded file (e.g., 'image/png', 'application/pdf').
contentType.title: Content Type

contentUrl.description: URL to download the uploaded file.
contentUrl.title: Content Url

deleted.description: If true, the attachment has been deleted.
deleted.title: Deleted

fileName.description: The name of the uploaded file.
fileName.title: File Name

height.description: Height of the image in pixels. Only present for image attachments. Zendesk returns this as an integer; the union accepts strings for forward-compatibility.
height.title: Height

id.description: Unique identifier for the uploaded attachment.
id.title: Id

inline.description: If true, the attachment is inline (displayed within the content).
inline.title: Inline

malwareAccessOverride.description: If true, you can download an attachment flagged as malware.
malwareAccessOverride.title: Malware Access Override

malwareScanResult.description: Result of malware scan. Possible values: 'malware_found', 'malware_not_found', 'failed_to_scan', 'not_scanned'.
malwareScanResult.title: Malware Scan Result

mappedContentUrl.description: Mapped content URL for the attachment.
mappedContentUrl.title: Mapped Content Url

size.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes.
size.title: Size

thumbnails.description: List of thumbnail objects for image attachments.
thumbnails.title: Thumbnails

upload_expires_at.description: Expiration time for the upload token.
upload_expires_at.title: Upload Expires At

upload_token.description: Token to use when attaching the file to a ticket. Valid for 60 minutes.
upload_token.title: Upload Token

url.description: API URL to access the attachment.
url.title: Url

width.description: Width of the image in pixels. Only present for image attachments. Zendesk returns this as an integer; the union accepts strings for forward-compatibility.
width.title: Width

height.title: Height
